An explicit decision, every time

From request to result.

01 / REQUEST

Your client requests a command.

Perch records the exact Bash command, working directory and timeout.

02 / APPROVE

You decide what runs.

Approve once, deny, or save a revocable rule for that exact command and client.

03 / EXECUTE

Follow the result.

The authenticated client executes the approved request and retrieves its output and completion status.

Get connected

Bring your own Perch server.

Install Perch on your Linux VPS using the repository's deployment guide. Set your public HTTPS address, then add <your-perch-url>/mcp to a compatible MCP client.

For ChatGPT, use a custom MCP connection with OAuth. Sign in to your own Perch instance and choose Connect this client. Connection permits command requests; you still control command approval.

Installation guideConnection guide

Perch is early alpha. Keep an independent recovery path such as SSH. Approval controls execution, but an approved privileged command can still change or damage your server.
